num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['number']).columns
import pandas as pd
import re

def clean_numeric(x):
    # Skip NaN
    if pd.isna(x):
        return x
    # Convert to string to remove unwanted characters
    x_str = str(x).strip()
    # Keep only digits, decimal point, minus sign
    x_str = re.sub(r'[^\d\.-]', '', x_str)
    
    # Convert back to float
    try:
        return float(x_str)
    except:
        return pd.NA  # or np.nan

# Apply only to numeric-like columns
df[num_cols] = df[num_cols].applymap(clean_numeric)
